_comment: Shown in the main menu (Options > Credits). Third-party assets and their licences; keep in step with rldb/assets/CREDITS.md. A line may hold links as [url=https://...]short label[/url]: the label is shown (never a raw address, which wraps mid-path), the address is its tooltip, and a click opens it.

sections.title: RLDB
lines: Card art, table and menu backgrounds and the soundtrack: supplied by the RLDB team.
Sound effects: generated for RLDB with [url=https://elevenlabs.io/sound-effects]ElevenLabs Sound Effects[/url], November 2026.

sections.title: Status icons
lines: From [url=https://game-icons.net]game-icons.net[/url], licensed under [url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/]Creative Commons Attribution 3.0[/url] (CC BY 3.0).
Lorc: rune stone, anchor, ankh, broadhead arrow, hood, sprint, semi-closed eye, cracked shield.
Delapouite: sparkles. Zeromancer: heart plus. Carl Olsen: flame. Skoll: pentacle, sight disabled. Darkzaitzev: death juice.
The glyphs are set, outlined and shaded, on enamelled badges made for RLDB (the Paralyse bolt and the Cleanse sparkle are RLDB's own).

sections.title: Surface textures
lines: Leather032, Leather030, Wood051 and Metal009 from [url=https://ambientcg.com]ambientCG[/url], licensed under [url=https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/]CC0 1.0[/url].
Converted to greyscale relief maps for the interface.

sections.title: Fonts
lines: Cinzel (The Cinzel Project Authors) and Alegreya Sans (The Alegreya Sans Project Authors), under the [url=https://openfontlicense.org]SIL Open Font License 1.1[/url].
RLDB Symbols, a subset of Noto Sans Symbols 2 (The Noto Project Authors), under the [url=https://openfontlicense.org]SIL Open Font License 1.1[/url].

sections.title: Engine
lines: Made with the [url=https://godotengine.org]Godot Engine[/url], under the [url=https://godotengine.org/license]MIT licence[/url].
Steam features through [url=https://godotsteam.com]GodotSteam[/url], under the MIT licence.
